articles.title: How a Viral Escalator Video Sparked Norway's World Cup Rallying Cry
articles.summary: A video of Norwegian fans rowing on an escalator in Boston went viral. Now the 'Viking Row' has spread to Norway's parliament and united the nation.

articles.title: Supreme Court Allows Trump to End Protections for Haitian and Syrian Immigrants
articles.summary: In a 6-3 ruling, the Supreme Court gave President Trump the power to end TPS for Haitians and Syrians. Hundreds of thousands face deportation.

articles.title: Gulf States Back US-Iran Deal: Pragmatism Trumps Conflict
articles.summary: After a war they never wanted, Gulf nations are supporting a US-Iran agreement. They seek diplomacy over confrontation, even after Iran attacked their cities.
